evidence.quote: Traffic is billed hourly and takes into account the number of virtual machines running during the last one-hour period. Effectively, there are 1.42 GiB of free output traffic per instance. If an instance doesn’t use its free tier, it is reported on other running instances of the same organization. So, with 5 instances running during the last hour, there are 7.1 GiB of free output traffic. The exceeding traffic is billed.
